Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's fine. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was heading down a two-lane road, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour. It was a clear afternoon and the road
was dry.
Q: Can you tell me what happened next?
A: The other car came over into my lane. I braked and turned the wheel, but we still met nearly head-on. It wasn't a
hard hit, more like a jolt, but my hands went forward and hit the steering wheel.
Q: Did you feel any pain right away?
A: My right wrist hurt almost immediately, and it swelled up fast. I kept my hand against my chest for the drive to the
clinic.
Q: Were you taken to a medical facility?
A: Yes. They took X-rays and told me the wrist was fractured. I've been in a splint since then and I have a follow-up
appointment next week.
Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle sustain injuries?
A: No, I was alone in the car. The other driver seemed shaken but walked around without help.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I'm keeping every receipt and record from the clinic, and I'm happy to send them over.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
